circuit.page: p6 fig 3 (values garbled in the text: [mem] 100 nF + 4.7 uF)

circuit.role: XSHUT pull-up (pin must always be driven)

supplies.AVDD: 2.6-3.5 V (2.8 typ); 3.3 V is inside the range

logic: Default I/O mode is 1.8 V; '2V8 mode' (set by the driver at init) makes SDA/SCL/XSHUT/GPIO1 levels equal AVDD (p23 note 3). Pins rated to 3.6 V absolute (p23), VIH min 1.12 V in standard mode (p24). So: 3.3 V bus direct, firmware must select 2V8 mode.

i2c_addr.select: default 0x52 as an 8-bit value = 0x29 (p4, p19); can be reprogrammed after each power-up (volatile). Left at 0x29; the VL53L5CX is the one moved.

expander: TOF_PWR_EN (rail switch shared with the VL53L5CX)

placement: Top side under an infrared-transmissive window (940 nm); a window that looks black is fine. Full field of view 27 deg (p1, p15).
Cover window as close to the module as possible with a small air gap [mem: under about 0.5 mm]; crosstalk and offset calibration are then required (p9).
No light path from the emitter to the AS7341/OPT4001 window. Keep the cone clear of the case edge.
notes: Two rangefinders share 0x29: see the VL53L5CX file for the start-up order.
XSHUT high only when AVDD is on (p23 note 2): raise it after TOF_PWR_EN.
